description:
## [1.4.8](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.7...v1.4.8) (2026-11-03)

### ✨ New Features

* add local follows, alerts, filters and playback diagnostics ([1180bcf](https://github.com/snowyegret23/morphe-patches/commit/1180bcfb4583966e66e906fbf24fffa44dfe41a1))

patches.name: Auto claim TongPow
patches.description: Claims watch-time TongPow through the app's claim button handler. Can be disabled in Morphe settings.

patches.name: CDN playback
patches.description: Creates player configurations with peer-assisted streaming disabled.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs alongside the original app using a separate package name and app data.

options.description: 원본과 함께 설치할 앱의 고유 이름입니다. 업데이트할 때도 같은 값을 사용하세요.

patches.name: Chat customization
patches.description: Adds in-player Morphe settings, draggable chat width, chat styling, individual badge controls, device icons, chat input buttons, live viewer count, live rewind and catch-up, audio compression and volume boost, player button visibility, recent chat and settings copy/paste.

patches.name: Custom app branding
patches.description: Changes the app name shown by Android. Defaults to 치지직 S.

options.description: 홈 화면과 Android 앱 목록에 표시할 이름입니다.

patches.name: Home without promotions
patches.description: Removes home carousels, campaign exposure and promotional topic rows while preserving content rows.

patches.name: Playback without ads
patches.description: Skips player ad-source wrapping, ignores live ad events and removes AD cards from the clip feed.
